1.consolidated_definition: Ascender a alguien, darle una categoría superior, aprobar a un estudiante para que alcance el grado inmediato superior.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To promote someone to a higher category, grant a student permission to advance to the next highest level of study or academic degree.
